name: Midnight in the Squ4ll of the Damned v10
author: Squ4ll

name: Blacksmith
ability: You start knowing how many Outsiders are in play. All Outsiders are drunk, even if you are dead. [-? to +? Outsiders]

name: Pirate
ability: You start knowing how many Pirates are in play. If Pirates are the only good character alive, good wins. [+0 to +2 Pirates]
firstNightReminder: Wake a Pirate. Give a finger signal. Put the Pirate to sleep. Repeat for all Pirates.

name: Falconer
ability: Each dusk*, you may visit the Storyteller to learn how many Townsfolk are alive. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

name: Merchant
edition: Midnight in the Squ4ll of the Damned
ability: Once per game, you & another player may publicly make a deal: if 1 of you breaks the rule, that player's team loses.
flavor: Would you make a deal to trade up to $500 in cash for one of these three doors, knowing behind one of them is $3,254 in cash or valuable merchandise? Several people may have to make that decision during the next few minutes as we bring you the Marketplace Of Ravenswood Bluff. LET'S MAKE A DEAL!

name: Machinist
ability: On your 1st day, visit the Storyteller to become a non-listed character, even if drunk or poisoned. [+0 to +2 Machinists]

name: Mole
ability: You are a Minion too. If the Demon publicly guesses you (once), your team loses, even if dead, drunk or poisoned.
firstNightReminder:
Wake the Mole. Show them which Minion character they are.
Wake the Mole when giving Minion info.
When giving Demon info, point to the Mole as if they are a Minion.

name: Beekeeper
ability: You choose which 3 good characters (not the Beekeeper) the Demon gets as bluffs.
firstNightReminder:
Wake the Beekeeper. They point at three good characters (not the Beekeeper).
During Demon info, show the Demon these three characters instead of the three bluffs.

name: Taxman
ability: Evil can't win. The 1st time evil would win, the Demon learns you are the Taxman tonight.
otherNightReminder: If evil would have won for the first time, wake the Demon and point to the Taxman. :reminder:

name: Shaman
ability: Minions & Demons think they are different evil characters. At night, the Storyteller acts for them.
otherNightReminder: If the Shaman died today or tonight, wake any evil player. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show their character token. Put the evil player to sleep. Repeat until you have woken all evil players.

name: Troll
edition: Midnight in the Squ4ll of the Damned
ability: Each night, choose your alignment. On the final night, even if you are dead, 1 player learns a Troll is in play.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Troll. They give either a thumbs-up or a thumbs-down. Put the Troll to sleep.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Troll. They give either a thumbs-up or a thumbs-down. Put the Troll to sleep.

name: Donkey Wrangler
ability: If you are nominated, the Demon must be executed today, or your team loses. [Your token is square]

name: Copycat
edition: Midnight in the Squ4ll of the Damned
ability: You are also the character of another in-play Minion. [There must be another Minion]
firstNightReminder: Wake the Copycat. Show a character token.

name: Damned
ability: If all good players die, good wins. The Demon cannot kill the last living Damned. [+0 to +2 Damned]

name: Hwisp
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a Townsfolk nominates you, you die. Each day, if 2 Townsfolk nominate, evil wins.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Hwisp. They point to any player. That player dies. :reminder:

name: Tipi-Tipi
ability: Each night*, a player dies. On the final night, choose 2 players: the 1st is mad the 2nd is not the Demon, or their team loses.
flavor: That fucking bird that I hate! That fucking bird that I hate!
otherNightReminder:
A player dies. :reminder:
If it is the final night, wake the Tipi-Tipi. They point to 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Wake the player marked *1st* and show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* info card, then the Tipi-Tipi token. Point to the player marked *2nd*.

name: Fanzazz
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die & you become their alignment. If you die, your team loses. If just 2 players live, your team wins.
otherNightReminder:
Wake the Fanzazz. They point to any player. That player dies. :reminder:
If that player died and they are a different alignment than the Fanzazz, flip the Fanzazz’ reminder token. Give a thumbs-up or thumbs-down.
